semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

semantics.purpose: Group applicability and completeness semantics for deterministic canonical reconstruction.

semantics.completeness_definition: A semantic surface is complete when every applicable required semantic dimension is explicitly reconstructable, all required internal references are closed, and no unresolved active gap affects that surface.

applicability_states.required: The semantic surface must be present and deterministic.
applicability_states.optional: The semantic surface may be absent without creating a gap.
applicability_states.not_applicable: The semantic surface is intentionally inapplicable and that inapplicability is explicit or deterministically implied by Contract Format/type rules.

semantics.empty_vs_missing_rule: An explicit empty collection can mean 'applicable but currently contains zero items'. A missing required semantic surface means 'unknown/unrepresented' and is not equivalent to empty.
semantics.not_applicable_rule: Not-applicable is a semantic statement, not a parser convenience. A generic reader must be able to determine why the surface does not apply.
semantics.lock_rule: A contract cannot become lock-eligible while any applicable required semantic surface is incomplete.
semantics.scope_rule: Completeness is evaluated per semantic surface and recursively for the active graph; one complete contract does not imply repository-wide completeness.

invariants.rule: Explicit empty and missing are distinct semantic states.
Completeness claims retain machine-readable evidence references.

hard_gates.condition: An applicable required semantic surface is absent or cannot be reconstructed.
A missing required surface is silently normalized to an empty collection.
A required semantic surface is skipped as not_applicable without deterministic format/type evidence.
A semantic surface is marked complete while an unresolved active gap affects it.
A semantic surface is marked complete while a required internal reference remains outside reference closure.

references.purpose: Required internal references must be closed for semantic completeness.
Unresolved active gaps make their affected semantic surfaces incomplete.
Semantic completeness is a prerequisite for lock eligibility.

prose.summary: Defines the difference between complete, incomplete, empty and not-applicable canonical semantics and makes completeness an explicit prerequisite for locking.
notes: Unlocked until the Contract Format itself explicitly defines applicability for all required 1.4 semantic surfaces.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.
